name: scroff
description: Scroff — a scratch-and-win lucky draw game

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
scripts.netlify-build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npx --prefix server prisma migrate deploy --schema=./server/prisma/schema.prisma
